ability.name: Lantern Glow
ability.tooltip_en: Shields the monster with the lowest health.
ability.tooltip_id: Shields the monster with the lowest health.

ability.name: Rock Charge
ability.tooltip_en: Charges its target.
ability.tooltip_id: Charges its target.

ability.name: Root Slam
ability.tooltip_en: Slams the ground and stuns every enemy next to it.
ability.tooltip_id: Slams the ground and stuns every enemy next to it.

ability.name: Toll
ability.tooltip_en: Strikes the bell in his chest; every enemy within two tiles is stunned.
ability.tooltip_id: Strikes the bell in his chest; every enemy within two tiles is stunned.

ability.name: Mending Spores
ability.tooltip_en: Heals the monster with the lowest health.
ability.tooltip_id: Heals the monster with the lowest health.

ability.name: Stone Wings
ability.tooltip_en: Opens its wings and guards the monsters behind it.
ability.tooltip_id: Opens its wings and guards the monsters behind it.

ability.name: Mud Spit
ability.tooltip_en: Spits mud that damages a small area around its target.
ability.tooltip_id: Spits mud that damages a small area around its target.

ability.name: Rockslide Charge
ability.tooltip_en: Lowers his head and charges his target.
ability.tooltip_id: Lowers his head and charges his target.

ability.name: Rose Window
ability.tooltip_en: Two beams of coloured light cross the board through her target.
ability.tooltip_id: Two beams of coloured light cross the board through her target.

ability.name: Deep Grove
ability.tooltip_en: Grass spreads around her and heals every monster standing on it.
ability.tooltip_id: Grass spreads around her and heals every monster standing on it.

ability.name: Flood
ability.tooltip_en: A wave rolls down her lane, damaging and pushing back every enemy in it.
ability.tooltip_id: A wave rolls down her lane, damaging and pushing back every enemy in it.

ability.name: Heartlight
ability.tooltip_en: Two beams of the grove's light cross the board through its target.
ability.tooltip_id: Two beams of the grove's light cross the board through its target.

ability.name: Grasping Roots
ability.tooltip_en: Taunts adjacent enemies: they must attack the treant.
ability.tooltip_id: Memancing musuh di sebelahnya: mereka harus menyerang treant.

steps.text_en: Drag each hero from the bench onto your half of the board. Your level (3) is how many heroes you may field.
steps.text_id: Seret setiap hero dari bangku cadangan ke separuh papanmu. Levelmu (3) adalah jumlah hero yang boleh kamu turunkan.

steps.text_en: Press Ready to start the fight.
steps.text_id: Tekan Siap untuk memulai pertarungan.

steps.text_en: Watch the fight. Heroes move, attack and use their skills by themselves.
steps.text_id: Saksikan pertarungan. Hero bergerak, menyerang, dan memakai skill dengan sendirinya.

steps.text_en: Open the shop.
steps.text_id: Buka toko.

steps.text_en: Buy both Hammerers. Three copies of the same hero merge into one two-star hero.
steps.text_id: Beli kedua Hammerer. Tiga hero yang sama bergabung menjadi satu hero bintang dua.

steps.text_en: Close the shop and buy experience to reach level 4. A higher level fields more heroes and shows stronger heroes in the shop.
steps.text_id: Tutup toko dan beli pengalaman untuk mencapai level 4. Level lebih tinggi menurunkan lebih banyak hero dan menampilkan hero lebih kuat di toko.

steps.text_en: Field your fourth hero from the bench.
steps.text_id: Turunkan hero keempatmu dari bangku cadangan.

steps.text_en: Press Ready to start the fight.
steps.text_id: Tekan Siap untuk memulai pertarungan.

steps.text_en: Watch the fight.
steps.text_id: Saksikan pertarungan.

steps.text_en: Open the shop and buy Ironwall. He is a Tank, like your Shieldbearer.
steps.text_id: Buka toko dan beli Ironwall. Ia seorang Tank, seperti Shieldbearer milikmu.

steps.text_en: Close the shop and field Ironwall. Two different Tanks switch on the Tank synergy: more armour for both.
steps.text_id: Tutup toko dan turunkan Ironwall. Dua Tank yang berbeda mengaktifkan sinergi Tank: armor lebih besar untuk keduanya.

steps.text_en: Click Tank in the synergy list to read its bonus.
steps.text_id: Klik Tank di daftar sinergi untuk membaca bonusnya.

steps.text_en: Press Ready to start the fight.
steps.text_id: Tekan Siap untuk memulai pertarungan.

steps.text_en: Watch the fight. The panel on the right shows who deals and takes damage.
steps.text_id: Saksikan pertarungan. Panel di kanan menunjukkan siapa yang memberi dan menerima kerusakan.

steps.text_en: Your archer stands in front and your tank at the back. Move Shieldbearer to the front row, the one nearest the enemy.
steps.text_id: Pemanahmu berdiri di depan dan tank-mu di belakang. Pindahkan Shieldbearer ke baris depan, baris yang paling dekat dengan musuh.

steps.text_en: Move Longbow Scout to one of the two back rows, where melee enemies reach her last.
steps.text_id: Pindahkan Longbow Scout ke salah satu dari dua baris belakang, tempat musuh jarak dekat paling lambat mencapainya.

steps.text_en: Press Ready to start the fight.
steps.text_id: Tekan Siap untuk memulai pertarungan.

steps.text_en: Watch the fight.
steps.text_id: Saksikan pertarungan.

steps.text_en: You have 9 gold. Every 10 gold you hold pays 1 more gold each round. Select Jinxer on your bench and sell it to reach 10. Winning or losing 3 fights in a row also pays extra.
steps.text_id: Kamu punya 9 emas. Setiap 10 emas yang kamu simpan memberi 1 emas tambahan tiap ronde. Pilih Jinxer di bangku cadangan dan jual untuk mencapai 10. Menang atau kalah 3 kali berturut-turut juga memberi emas tambahan.

steps.text_en: Lock the shop to keep these offers for the next round.
steps.text_id: Kunci toko agar tawaran ini tetap ada di ronde berikutnya.

steps.text_en: Every tenth round is a boss. Press Ready.
steps.text_id: Setiap ronde kesepuluh adalah bos. Tekan Siap.

steps.text_en: Watch the fight.
steps.text_id: Saksikan pertarungan.

steps.text_en: A boss round is followed by a relic. Choose one of the three.
steps.text_id: Ronde bos diikuti sebuah relik. Pilih satu dari tiga.

steps.text_en: Select one of your heroes, then equip the relic from the relic panel. That is the end of the guide.
steps.text_id: Pilih salah satu hero-mu, lalu pasang relik dari panel relik. Panduan selesai di sini.

dossier.form: Stocky knight in plain plate with one oversized tower shield.
dossier.decision: Choose which ally stands behind the shield.
dossier.positioning: Front row, facing the expected attackers, carry directly behind.
dossier.allies: Any fragile Mage, Sniper or Priest.
dossier.counterplay: Flank the shield or push him away from the protected ally.
dossier.recognition: The big shield glows and a short arc marks the guarded side.

ability.name: Shield Wall
ability.tooltip_en: Passively reduces eligible incoming attacks aimed at the one ally standing behind his guarded side.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengurangi serangan yang mengarah ke satu rekan di belakang sisi perisainya. Serang dari samping atau pisahkan mereka.

dossier.form: Big-shouldered orc with tusks, a boar-skull helm and a heavy club.
dossier.decision: Build a long run-up into a big first hit.
dossier.positioning: Far from the target with an open lane.
dossier.allies: Orcs for health; Fighters for damage.
dossier.counterplay: Screen or crowd the lane; block the landing cell.
dossier.recognition: Dust trail grows with momentum, then a streak on the charge.

ability.name: Tusk Charge
ability.tooltip_en: Movement builds momentum; a clear straight path triggers a charge that turns momentum into a heavy hit.
ability.tooltip_id: Bergerak mengumpulkan momentum; jalur lurus yang kosong memicu serudukan yang mengubah momentum menjadi pukulan berat.

dossier.form: Antlered elf elder in a leaf mantle with a twisted wooden staff.
dossier.decision: Anchor a healing zone the team fights inside.
dossier.positioning: Centre of the formation, where she will not need to walk.
dossier.allies: Tanks and Fighters who hold ground next to her.
dossier.counterplay: Burst her before the grove establishes, or displace her.
dossier.recognition: A ring of flowers grows on the healed cells and pulses.

ability.name: Sacred Grove
ability.tooltip_en: After standing still, establishes a pulsing healing area; moving, displacement, stun or defeat breaks it.
ability.tooltip_id: Setelah diam, menciptakan area penyembuhan berdenyut. Bergerak, terdorong, pingsan, atau kalah akan memutusnya.

dossier.form: Wiry goblin with a metal jaw-guard and a hooked chain.
dossier.decision: Reach a distant enemy unless something stands in the way.
dossier.positioning: On a line with an unscreened enemy carry.
dossier.allies: Assassins; units that open lanes by pushing.
dossier.counterplay: Put a defender in the line.
dossier.recognition: The chain line is shown before the hook flies.

ability.name: Chain Hook
ability.tooltip_en: Commits toward a distant enemy and hits the first enemy the straight line meets.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyerang ke arah musuh jauh dan mengenai musuh pertama yang dilewati garis lurus.

dossier.form: Slim scholar in a long coat carrying a large floating crystal.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies lined up in rows and columns.
dossier.positioning: Protected back row with a clear view of the enemy cluster.
dossier.allies: Shieldbearer in front; Mages for the skill-damage bonus.
dossier.counterplay: Spread across rows and columns; interrupt the unreleased cast.
dossier.recognition: The crystal splits light into a visible cross before each beam fires.

ability.name: Crossfire
ability.tooltip_en: Locks a crossing point, then releases a row beam followed by a column beam.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengunci titik silang, lalu melepaskan sinar baris disusul sinar kolom.

dossier.form: Water-bodied figure with a wave-shaped crest and trailing droplets.
dossier.decision: Break a formation by pushing its front unit away.
dossier.positioning: On the lane holding the enemy's key front-liner.
dossier.allies: Shieldbearer's counter; allies that punish displaced units.
dossier.counterplay: Stagger the formation; block the push cell.
dossier.recognition: A wave rolls down the lane and carries one enemy back.

ability.name: Tidal Wave
ability.tooltip_en: Damages enemies in the facing lane and pushes the first enemy back through free cells.
ability.tooltip_id: Melukai musuh di jalur depan dan mendorong musuh pertama ke belakang melalui petak kosong.

dossier.form: Thin horned demon carrying a hanging iron cage on a chain.
dossier.decision: Take one enemy out of the fight.
dossier.positioning: Behind a defender, within reach of approaching enemies.
dossier.allies: Shieldbearer; allies that focus the caged unit.
dossier.counterplay: Interrupt the wind-up; pressure him during the long cooldown.
dossier.recognition: The cage flies out and closes around one enemy.

ability.name: Soul Cage
ability.tooltip_en: Fires a cage at one enemy; on impact it cannot move, attack or cast for a short time. No damage.
ability.tooltip_id: Menembakkan kurungan ke satu musuh; sasaran tidak dapat bergerak, menyerang, atau memakai kemampuan sesaat. Tanpa kerusakan.

dossier.form: Robed cleric with a tall hood and a large lantern staff.
dossier.decision: Keep one key ally alive through burst.
dossier.positioning: Back row, away from Assassin landing cells.
dossier.counterplay: Dive her with Assassins or silence her.
dossier.recognition: A beam of light links the lantern to the healed ally.

ability.name: Mending Light
ability.tooltip_en: Heals the allied unit with the lowest health.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyembuhkan rekan dengan nyawa paling rendah.

dossier.form: Short broad dwarf with a braided beard and a huge two-handed hammer.
dossier.decision: Lock down the unit in front of him.
dossier.positioning: Front row opposite a dangerous melee enemy.
dossier.allies: Dwarves for shields; Fighters for damage.
dossier.counterplay: Kite him with ranged units.
dossier.recognition: The hammer glows, then an impact star appears over the target.

ability.name: Stunning Blow
ability.tooltip_en: Strikes the current target and stuns it briefly.
ability.tooltip_id: Memukul sasaran saat ini dan membuatnya pingsan sesaat.

dossier.form: Massive orc with stone gauntlets and a single shoulder plate.
dossier.decision: Stop a melee pile-up around him.
dossier.positioning: Front row where enemies gather.
dossier.counterplay: Do not surround him; use ranged units.
dossier.recognition: Raised fists, then cracks spread to adjacent cells.

ability.name: Ground Slam
ability.tooltip_en: Slams the ground and stuns all adjacent enemies.
ability.tooltip_id: Menghantam tanah dan membuat semua musuh di sebelahnya pingsan.

dossier.form: Round bear-headed bruiser with huge paws and a leather harness.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies that cluster around him.
dossier.positioning: Front row.
dossier.counterplay: Fight him one at a time or from range.
dossier.recognition: A wide claw arc sweeps around him.

ability.name: Wide Swipe
ability.tooltip_en: Hits every adjacent enemy with one swipe.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengenai semua musuh di sebelahnya dengan satu sapuan.

dossier.form: Tiny green goblin with big ears carrying a round bomb as large as his torso.
dossier.decision: Cheap early area damage.
dossier.positioning: Second row.
dossier.counterplay: Spread out; he is fragile.
dossier.recognition: A lit fuse, an arc, and a small blast circle.

ability.name: Lobbed Bomb
ability.tooltip_en: Throws a bomb that damages a small area around the target.
ability.tooltip_id: Melempar bom yang melukai area kecil di sekitar sasaran.

dossier.form: Small floating flame spirit with two round eyes and tiny arms.
dossier.decision: Cheap early protection.
dossier.positioning: Behind the front line.
dossier.counterplay: Burst through the shield.
dossier.recognition: A warm bubble surrounds the shielded ally.

ability.name: Warm Ward
ability.tooltip_en: Places a small shield on the ally with the lowest health.
ability.tooltip_id: Memberi perisai kecil pada rekan dengan nyawa paling rendah.

dossier.form: Heavy orc with painted arms beating a large waist drum.
dossier.decision: Speed up a melee group at the right moment.
dossier.positioning: Just behind the front line, next to Fighters.
dossier.counterplay: Kill the buffed group's back support; stun during the buff.
dossier.recognition: Red rings pulse out from the drum.

ability.name: War Drum
ability.tooltip_en: Raises the attack speed of nearby allies for a few seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Menaikkan kecepatan serang rekan di sekitarnya selama beberapa detik.

heroes.name: Siege Master
heroes.design_intent: Siege Shell: Fires a cannon shell at the largest enemy cluster, damaging an area.

dossier.form: Broad artillerist with goggles wheeling a short fat cannon.
dossier.decision: Reward enemy clumping with area damage.
dossier.positioning: Far back row; needs time to charge.
dossier.allies: Tanks that hold enemies together; Engineers for mana.
dossier.counterplay: Spread out or reach him quickly.
dossier.recognition: A marked circle appears before the shell lands.

ability.name: Siege Shell
ability.tooltip_en: Lobs a shell at the largest group of enemies in reach, dealing magic damage to everyone within 1 cell.
ability.tooltip_id: Melontarkan peluru ke kelompok musuh terbesar dalam jangkauan, memberi kerusakan sihir kepada semua dalam 1 petak.

heroes.name: Longbow Scout
heroes.design_intent: Piercing Arrow: Shoots an arrow that damages every enemy in a straight line.

dossier.form: Slender archer with long ears, a green hood and a bow taller than herself.
dossier.decision: Line up shots through several enemies.
dossier.positioning: Back row on a column the enemy fills.
dossier.allies: Other Snipers; a Tank in front.
dossier.counterplay: Stagger columns; send Assassins.
dossier.recognition: The arrow leaves a thin bright trail through its line.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.tooltip_en: Shoots an arrow through the current target that damages every enemy in that line.
ability.tooltip_id: Menembakkan panah menembus target saat ini yang melukai setiap musuh di garis itu.

heroes.name: Moonblade
heroes.design_intent: Moon Step: Blinks behind the farthest enemy and deals a guaranteed critical strike.

dossier.form: Lean masked elf with two crescent blades and a short cape.
dossier.decision: Remove the enemy's farthest back-line unit.
dossier.positioning: Anywhere; she relocates when her skill fires.
dossier.allies: Other Assassins to overload the back line.
dossier.counterplay: Keep a bodyguard near the back-line carry.
dossier.recognition: A crescent flash at the start cell and behind the target.

ability.name: Moon Step
ability.tooltip_en: Blinks behind the farthest enemy and strikes it with a guaranteed critical hit (150% damage).
ability.tooltip_id: Berpindah ke belakang musuh terjauh dan menebasnya dengan serangan kritis yang pasti (150% kerusakan).

heroes.name: Treant Caller
heroes.design_intent: Call Treant: Summons a treant that taunts nearby enemies.

dossier.form: Tall elf in bark armour holding a glowing seed.
dossier.decision: Add a disposable front-liner that pulls attacks.
dossier.positioning: Second row so the treant appears in front.
dossier.counterplay: Area damage clears the treant; ignore it with Assassins.
dossier.recognition: The seed is thrown and a treant bursts from the cell.

ability.name: Call Treant
ability.tooltip_en: Summons a treant beside her. It fights until it falls and taunts the enemies next to it.
ability.tooltip_id: Memanggil treant di sebelahnya. Ia bertarung sampai gugur dan memancing musuh di sebelahnya.

heroes.name: Ironwall
heroes.design_intent: Hold Fast: Taunts adjacent enemies and gains armour for a short time.

dossier.form: Squat dwarf sealed in thick armour with two bolted shields.
dossier.decision: Force nearby enemies to hit the toughest unit.
dossier.positioning: Front and centre.
dossier.allies: Priests and Warlocks that heal him.
dossier.counterplay: Skill damage ignores armour; kill his back line first.
dossier.recognition: Shields slam together and red lines pull enemy attention.

ability.name: Hold Fast
ability.tooltip_en: Braces for 4 seconds, gaining armour, and taunts adjacent enemies for 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds: they must attack him.
ability.tooltip_id: Bertahan selama 4 detik dan mendapat armor tambahan, serta memancing musuh di sebelahnya selama 2 / 2,5 / 3 detik: mereka harus menyerangnya.

heroes.name: Rifleman
heroes.design_intent: Long Shot: Fires one heavy shot at the farthest enemy.

dossier.form: Dwarf with a wide hat and a rifle longer than he is tall.
dossier.decision: Pressure the enemy back line from safety.
dossier.positioning: Back corner.
dossier.allies: Snipers for range; a Tank screen.
dossier.counterplay: Assassins; put a Tank farthest away as bait.
dossier.recognition: A long aiming line appears before the shot.

ability.name: Long Shot
ability.tooltip_en: Fires one heavy shot at the farthest enemy for physical damage.
ability.tooltip_id: Menembakkan satu tembakan berat ke musuh terjauh dengan kerusakan fisik.

heroes.name: Forge King
heroes.design_intent: Rocket Barrage: Launches rockets at several random cells on the enemy side.

dossier.form: Crowned dwarf riding a chunky walking forge with rocket racks.
dossier.decision: Late-game area damage across the whole enemy board.
dossier.positioning: Back row, well protected.
dossier.allies: Engineers for mana; Dwarves for shields.
dossier.counterplay: Kill or silence him before the barrage; spread out.
dossier.recognition: Racks open, rockets arc up and target marks appear.

ability.name: Rocket Barrage
ability.tooltip_en: Launches 3 rockets at the positions of random enemies. Each deals magic damage to everyone within 1 cell.
ability.tooltip_id: Meluncurkan 3 roket ke posisi musuh acak. Tiap roket memberi kerusakan sihir kepada semua dalam 1 petak.

heroes.name: Jinxer
heroes.design_intent: Jinx: Reduces the current target's attack damage for a few seconds.

dossier.form: Hunched goblin in a feathered mask shaking a bone rattle.
dossier.decision: Weaken the enemy's main attacker.
dossier.positioning: Mid row, facing the enemy carry.
dossier.counterplay: Skill-based damage is unaffected.
dossier.recognition: A purple mark hangs over the weakened enemy.

ability.name: Jinx
ability.tooltip_en: Hits the current target for magic damage and lowers its attack damage for 4 seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyerang target saat ini dengan kerusakan sihir dan menurunkan kerusakan serangannya selama 4 detik.

heroes.name: Dartblower
heroes.design_intent: Poison Dart: Poisons the target: damage over time and slower attacks.

dossier.form: Skinny goblin in a leaf cloak with a long blowpipe.
dossier.decision: Wear down one high-health enemy.
dossier.positioning: Back row.
dossier.counterplay: Healing outlasts the poison; dive him.
dossier.recognition: Green bubbles rise from the poisoned unit.

ability.name: Poison Dart
ability.tooltip_en: Poisons the current target for 4 seconds: magic damage every second, and it attacks more slowly.
ability.tooltip_id: Meracuni target saat ini selama 4 detik: kerusakan sihir setiap detik, dan serangannya melambat.

heroes.name: Bonechanter
heroes.design_intent: Draining Chain: Drains life from an enemy; the drain chains to nearby enemies and heals him.

dossier.form: Tall orc in a bone headdress with a skull-topped staff.
dossier.decision: Sustain himself against grouped enemies.
dossier.positioning: Second row near the fight.
dossier.counterplay: Spread out; burst him.
dossier.recognition: Red threads link him to each drained enemy.

ability.name: Draining Chain
ability.tooltip_en: Drains the current target, then up to 2 more enemies within 2 cells of each one hit, for magic damage, and heals himself.
ability.tooltip_id: Menguras target saat ini, lalu hingga 2 musuh lain dalam 2 petak dari tiap korban, dengan kerusakan sihir, dan menyembuhkan dirinya.

heroes.name: Foxclaw
heroes.design_intent: Pounce: Leaps onto the target and makes it bleed over time.

dossier.form: Small fox-headed fighter with a big tail and two claws.
dossier.decision: Early back-line pressure.
dossier.positioning: A flank column.
dossier.counterplay: Guard the back line with a cheap melee unit.
dossier.recognition: Orange blur on the leap; red drops on the bleeding unit.

ability.name: Pounce
ability.tooltip_en: Leaps onto the current target from up to 4 cells away, strikes it for physical damage and makes it bleed for 4 seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Melompat ke target saat ini dari jarak hingga 4 petak, menyerangnya dengan kerusakan fisik, dan membuatnya berdarah selama 4 detik.

heroes.name: Wolf Caller
heroes.design_intent: Pack Call: Summons two wolves next to her.

dossier.form: Wolf-headed hunter with a fur mantle and a horn.
dossier.decision: Add bodies to the front line.
dossier.positioning: Second row with free cells in front.
dossier.counterplay: Area damage clears wolves.
dossier.recognition: A horn call, then two wolves jump in.

ability.name: Pack Call
ability.tooltip_en: Summons 2 wolves beside her. They fight until they fall. A side may have 4 summoned units at once.
ability.tooltip_id: Memanggil 2 serigala di sebelahnya. Mereka bertarung sampai gugur. Satu pihak boleh memiliki 4 unit panggilan sekaligus.

heroes.name: Owl Seer
heroes.design_intent: Small Fry: Turns one enemy into a harmless critter for a few seconds.

dossier.form: Owl-headed sage in a feather cloak with a crooked staff.
dossier.decision: Remove the most dangerous enemy from the fight for a moment.
dossier.positioning: Mid row within reach of the enemy carry.
dossier.allies: Shamans; burst damage to finish the hexed unit.
dossier.counterplay: Bait the hex with a less important unit.
dossier.recognition: A puff of feathers and a tiny critter in the enemy's place.

ability.name: Small Fry
ability.tooltip_en: Turns the current target into a harmless critter for 2.5 / 3.5 / 5 seconds. It can walk, but cannot attack, cast or gain mana.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengubah target saat ini menjadi hewan kecil yang tak berbahaya selama 2,5 / 3,5 / 5 detik. Ia bisa berjalan, tetapi tidak bisa menyerang, memakai skill, atau mendapat mana.

heroes.name: Hellblade
heroes.design_intent: Burning Aura: Burns all adjacent enemies every second for a short time.

dossier.form: Red horned warrior with one burning greatsword.
dossier.decision: Deal steady damage in a melee pile.
dossier.positioning: Front row.
dossier.counterplay: Keep melee away; focus him.
dossier.recognition: A ring of flame circles his feet.

ability.name: Burning Aura
ability.tooltip_en: Ignites for 4 seconds: every second, all adjacent enemies take magic damage. The fire moves with him.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyala selama 4 detik: setiap detik, semua musuh di sebelahnya menerima kerusakan sihir. Api mengikuti dirinya.

heroes.name: Shadow Fiend
heroes.design_intent: Shadow Dash: Dashes in a straight line and damages every enemy crossed.

dossier.form: Dark winged demon with glowing eyes and long claws.
dossier.decision: Cut through a column of enemies.
dossier.positioning: On a column the enemy fills.
dossier.counterplay: Stagger columns.
dossier.recognition: A dark streak across the dashed cells.

ability.name: Shadow Dash
ability.tooltip_en: Dashes up to 4 cells in a straight line through the current target, dealing physical damage to every enemy on that line.
ability.tooltip_id: Menerjang hingga 4 petak dalam garis lurus melewati target saat ini, memberi kerusakan fisik kepada setiap musuh di garis itu.

heroes.name: Pit Lord
heroes.design_intent: Rain of Fire: Calls fire down on a large area for several seconds.

dossier.form: Huge horned demon with a burning crown and a heavy whip.
dossier.decision: Deny a large area of the board.
dossier.positioning: Back row, protected.
dossier.allies: Mages; Tanks that hold enemies in the area.
dossier.counterplay: Move out, spread, or silence him.
dossier.recognition: The area darkens, then fire falls in waves.

ability.name: Rain of Fire
ability.tooltip_en: Calls fire down around the current target for 4 seconds: every second, enemies within 2 cells of that spot take magic damage.
ability.tooltip_id: Menurunkan hujan api di sekitar target saat ini selama 4 detik: setiap detik, musuh dalam 2 petak dari titik itu menerima kerusakan sihir.

heroes.name: Bone Archer
heroes.design_intent: Splinter Arrow: Shoots an arrow that reduces the target's armour.

dossier.form: Skeleton in a torn hood with a bow made of ribs.
dossier.decision: Soften a tank for physical damage.
dossier.positioning: Back row.
dossier.counterplay: Assassins; armour matters less against skill damage.
dossier.recognition: A cracked-shield mark over the target.

ability.name: Splinter Arrow
ability.tooltip_en: Shoots the current target for physical damage and lowers its armour for 5 seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Menembak target saat ini dengan kerusakan fisik dan menurunkan armornya selama 5 detik.

heroes.name: Curse Weaver
heroes.design_intent: Hex of Frailty: Curses the target so it takes more damage from all sources.

dossier.form: Veiled ghoul with long sleeves and a floating curse doll.
dossier.decision: Mark the unit the team should kill next.
dossier.positioning: Mid row.
dossier.counterplay: Shields and healing on the cursed unit.
dossier.recognition: A doll icon hangs above the cursed enemy.

ability.name: Hex of Frailty
ability.tooltip_en: Curses the current target: magic damage, and it takes more damage from every source for 5 seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Mengutuk target saat ini: kerusakan sihir, dan target menerima kerusakan lebih besar dari semua sumber selama 5 detik.

heroes.name: Stitcher

dossier.form: Stitched-together surgeon with mismatched arms and a tool belt.
dossier.decision: Keep a damaged front-liner standing.
dossier.positioning: Second row.
dossier.counterplay: Burst past the shield; dive him.
dossier.recognition: Thread stitches across the ally and a pale shield appears.

ability.name: Patch Up
ability.tooltip_en: Heals the allied unit with the lowest health, then gives it a shield for 4 seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyembuhkan rekan dengan nyawa paling rendah, lalu memberinya perisai selama 4 detik.

heroes.design_intent: Patch Up: Repairs and shields the ally with the lowest health.

heroes.name: Necromancer
heroes.design_intent: Raise Dead: Raises skeletons from fallen units, up to the summon cap.

dossier.form: Gaunt robed figure with a crown of candles and a scythe.
dossier.decision: Grow stronger as the fight goes on.
dossier.positioning: Back row; long fights favour him.
dossier.allies: Summoners; Tanks that prolong the fight.
dossier.counterplay: Kill him early; area damage.
dossier.recognition: Green light rises from a fallen unit's cell.

ability.name: Raise Dead
ability.tooltip_en: Raises up to 2 skeletons where heroes or monsters have fallen. He waits until someone has fallen. A side may have 4 summoned units at once.
ability.tooltip_id: Membangkitkan hingga 2 kerangka di tempat hero atau monster gugur. Ia menunggu sampai ada yang gugur. Satu pihak boleh memiliki 4 unit panggilan sekaligus.

heroes.name: Stone Shaper
heroes.design_intent: Rock Wall: Raises a short rock wall that blocks cells for a few seconds.

dossier.form: Boulder-bodied figure with glowing cracks and oversized fists.
dossier.decision: Split the enemy formation or block a lane.
dossier.positioning: Front-centre facing the enemy's approach.
dossier.allies: Snipers and Mages who gain time.
dossier.counterplay: Walk around; ranged units ignore it.
dossier.recognition: Stone pillars rise from marked cells.

ability.name: Rock Wall
ability.tooltip_en: Raises 3 rock walls next to the current target for 4 seconds. Walls block cells and can be attacked, but do nothing themselves.
ability.tooltip_id: Mendirikan 3 dinding batu di sebelah target saat ini selama 4 detik. Dinding menghalangi petak dan bisa diserang, tetapi tidak berbuat apa-apa.

heroes.name: Storm Spirit
heroes.design_intent: Chain Lightning: Lightning hits the target and jumps to nearby enemies.

dossier.form: Cloud-bodied spirit with lightning arms and a bright core.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies standing next to each other.
dossier.positioning: Back row.
dossier.counterplay: Leave gaps between units.
dossier.recognition: A bolt visibly jumps from enemy to enemy.

ability.name: Chain Lightning
ability.tooltip_en: Strikes the current target with lightning that jumps to up to 3 more enemies within 2 cells of each one hit.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyambar target saat ini dengan petir yang melompat ke hingga 3 musuh lain dalam 2 petak dari tiap korban.

heroes.name: Scaleguard
heroes.design_intent: Thorn Scales: For a short time, returns part of the damage he takes to attackers.

dossier.form: Broad horned dragonkin with plated scales and a spiked tail.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies that focus him.
dossier.positioning: Front row.
dossier.counterplay: Stop attacking him while the scales glow; use skill damage.
dossier.recognition: Scales glow gold and sparks fly back at attackers.

ability.name: Thorn Scales
ability.tooltip_en: Raises thorned scales for 4 seconds: attackers take 30% / 45% / 65% of the damage they deal back as true damage.
ability.tooltip_id: Menegakkan sisik berduri selama 4 detik: penyerang menerima kembali 30% / 45% / 65% dari kerusakan yang mereka berikan sebagai kerusakan murni.

heroes.name: Dawn Oracle
heroes.design_intent: Dawn Chorus: Heals every ally for a moderate amount.

dossier.form: Slender winged dragonkin in white robes with a sun disc.
dossier.decision: Reset the whole team's health once.
dossier.positioning: Back row, protected.
dossier.counterplay: Burst single targets; reduce healing.
dossier.recognition: A sunrise glow sweeps across the allied side.

ability.name: Dawn Chorus
ability.tooltip_en: Heals every wounded ally, herself included.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyembuhkan setiap sekutu yang terluka, termasuk dirinya.

heroes.name: Flame Regent
heroes.design_intent: Regent's Breath: Breathes fire in a wide cone in front of him.

dossier.form: Tall crowned dragonkin with large wings and a red mantle.
dossier.decision: Late-game cone damage from the second row.
dossier.positioning: Second row facing the enemy cluster.
dossier.counterplay: Flank him; spread wide.
dossier.recognition: He rears back, then a cone of fire covers marked cells.

ability.name: Regent's Breath
ability.tooltip_en: Breathes fire toward the current target, dealing magic damage to every enemy in a wide cone 3 cells long.
ability.tooltip_id: Menyemburkan api ke arah target saat ini, memberi kerusakan sihir kepada setiap musuh dalam kerucut lebar sepanjang 3 petak.

heroes.name: Void Wyrm
heroes.design_intent: Mana Devour: Drains mana from nearby enemies and silences them briefly.

dossier.form: Dark-scaled dragonkin with hollow glowing chest and tattered wings.
dossier.decision: Shut down an enemy team that relies on skills.
dossier.positioning: Near the enemy's casters.
dossier.counterplay: Rely on basic attacks; keep casters apart.
dossier.recognition: Blue wisps are pulled from enemies into his chest.

ability.name: Mana Devour
ability.tooltip_en: Devours 50 / 75 / 100 mana from every enemy within 3 cells and silences them for 2.5 / 3.5 / 5 seconds. A silenced hero still attacks but cannot cast.
ability.tooltip_id: Melahap 50 / 75 / 100 mana dari setiap musuh dalam 3 petak dan membungkam mereka selama 2,5 / 3,5 / 5 detik. Hero yang dibungkam tetap menyerang tetapi tidak bisa memakai skill.

relics.name: Heavy Bloom
relics.description: +30% skill power (skill damage, healing and shields).
acceptance: Fits every hero.
Stat benefit is applied exactly once per combat.
Selling returns relic; merge survivor keeps own and returns extras.

traits.name: Orc
traits.behavior: Orcs gain +20% / +40% maximum health.

traits.behavior: All enemies lose 10 / 20 armour.
